name: glass-tab-bar
title: Glass Tab Bar
description: A floating Liquid Glass tab bar like iOS 26: a glass pill whose selected tab sits in a lighter bubble that springs between tabs, stretching as it travels and settling when it lands. Icons lift when selected, red count badges, optional labels and a separate circular trailing button (search) grouped with the bar so the two melt together on iOS 26. Real Liquid Glass on iOS 26, blur everywhere else; native-driver motion that respects Reduce Motion, selection haptics and a tablist for screen readers.
